text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After I've finished suggesting a training
schedule
to Admire Vega...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. Just taking in the fresh air...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing to worry about. I've taken
some
medicine, so it'll go away soon
enough.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Apologies for not telling
you
sooner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Admire Vega is struggling with
a
migraine...
